stages.title: IT operations and application support
stages.explain: Keeping business systems running meant writing down what was done and why, and staying calm when something broke at the worst moment. Those habits are coming with me into the trade.

stages.title: Certificate II in Electrotechnology
stages.explain: A pre-apprenticeship course covering the basics of electrical principles, tools and working safely. It's a common first step towards an electrical apprenticeship.

stages.title: Looking for an electrical apprenticeship
stages.learning: How apprenticeships work in NSW, and what employers look for in a first-year apprentice
stages.explain: An apprenticeship is paid work in the trade, alongside study, under the supervision of licensed electricians. Finding the right employer matters more than finding the first one.

stages.title: Apprenticeship and Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician (UEE30820)
stages.explain: Paid work on the tools under licensed electricians, with study alongside it. It finishes with the Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician, the qualification an electrician's licence is built on.

stages.title: Qualified supervisor certificate, electrician
stages.explain: The NSW certificate that lets an electrician carry out and supervise electrical work. On its own it doesn't allow contracting or advertising, so it isn't the finish line.

stages.title: Experience as a licensed electrician
stages.explain: Time working as a licensed electrician, learning how good contractors run their jobs, their paperwork and their businesses.

stages.title: Contractor licence, insurance, ABN and business name
stages.explain: In NSW, an electrical contractor licence is what allows someone to contract and advertise for electrical work, and every advertisement has to show the licence number. Insurance, an ABN and a registered business name are set up at the same stage.

stages.title: Salt and Light Electrical opens
stages.explain: The lamp lights up. Planned for {launchYear}, once licensed.
